001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.memory.IStateBool;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.IIntDeltaMonitor;
011import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
012import org.chocosolver.util.procedure.IntProcedure;
013
014/**
015 * if z in cond then x = y else x = 0
016 *
017 * @author jimmy
018 */
019public class PropContainsImpliesEqualCard extends Propagator<Variable> {
020
021    private final SetVar cond;
022    private final IntVar x, y;
023    private final IIntDeltaMonitor xD, yD;
024    private final int z;
025    // Support that x intersects y.
026    private int xSupportY = 0;
027    private final IStateBool condDecided;
028
029    public PropContainsImpliesEqualCard(SetVar cond, int z, IntVar x, IntVar y) {
030        super(new Variable[]{cond, x, y}, PropagatorPriority.UNARY, true);
031        this.cond = cond;
032        this.x = x;
033        this.xD = x.monitorDelta(this);
034        this.y = y;
035        this.yD = y.monitorDelta(this);
036        this.z = z;
037        this.condDecided = cond.getEnvironment().makeBool(false);
038    }
039
040    private boolean isCondVar(int vIdx) {
041        return vIdx == 0;
042    }
043
044    private boolean isXVar(int vIdx) {
045        return vIdx == 1;
046    }
047
048    private boolean isYVar(int vIdx) {
049        return vIdx == 2;
050    }
051
052//    @Override
053//    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
054//        if (vIdx == 0) {
055//            return SetEventType.all();
056//        }
057//        if (vIdx == 1) {
058//            return IntEventType.INSTANTIATE.getMask() + IntEventType.INCLOW.getMask();
059//        }
060//        assert vIdx == 2;
061//        return IntEventType.boundAndInst();
062//    }
063    @Override
064    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
065        int ub = x.getUB();
066        for (int i = x.getLB(); i <= ub; i = x.nextValue(i)) {
067            if (i != 0 && !y.contains(i)) {
068                x.removeValue(i, this);
069            }
070        }
071        if (!cond.getUB().contains(z) || y.isInstantiatedTo(0)) {
072            x.instantiateTo(0, this);
073            condDecided.set(true);
074            setPassive();
075        } else if (cond.getLB().contains(z) || !x.contains(0)) {
076            cond.force(z, this);
077            PropUtil.domSubsetDom(x, y, this);
078            PropUtil.domSubsetDom(y, x, this);
079            condDecided.set(true);
080        } else if (x.isInstantiatedTo(0)) {
081            if (!y.contains(0)) {
082                cond.remove(z, this);
083                condDecided.set(true);
084                setPassive();
085            }
086        }
087        xD.startMonitoring();
088        yD.startMonitoring();
089    }
090
091    private boolean xIntersectsY() {
092        if (x.contains(xSupportY) && y.contains(xSupportY)) {
093            return true;
094        }
095        xSupportY = PropUtil.getDomIntersectDom(x, x);
096        return xSupportY != Integer.MAX_VALUE;
097    }
098
099    @Override
100    public void propagate(int idxVarInProp, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
101        if (isCondVar(idxVarInProp) || (!x.contains(0) && cond.force(z, this))) {
102            if (!condDecided.get()) {
103                if (cond.getLB().contains(z)) {
104                    PropUtil.domSubsetDom(x, y, this);
105                    PropUtil.domSubsetDom(y, x, this);
106                    condDecided.set(true);
107                } else if (!cond.getUB().contains(z)) {
108                    x.instantiateTo(0, this);
109                    condDecided.set(true);
110                    setPassive();
111                }
112            }
113        } else if (isXVar(idxVarInProp)) {
114            if (!xIntersectsY()) {
115                cond.remove(z, this);
116                x.instantiateTo(0, this);
117                condDecided.set(true);
118                setPassive();
119            } else if (cond.getLB().contains(z)) {
120                xD.forEachRemVal((IntProcedure) xRem -> y.removeValue(xRem, this));
121            }
122            propagate(mask);
123        } else {
124            assert isYVar(idxVarInProp);
125            if (cond.getLB().contains(z)) {
126                yD.forEachRemVal((IntProcedure) yRem -> x.removeValue(yRem, this));
127            } else {
128                yD.forEachRemVal((IntProcedure) yRem -> {
129                    if (yRem != 0) {
130                        x.removeValue(yRem, this);
131                    }
132                });
133            }
134            if (x.isInstantiatedTo(0) && !y.contains(0)) {
135                cond.remove(z, this);
136                condDecided.set(true);
137                setPassive();
138            }
139        }
140    }
141
142    @Override
143    public ESat isEntailed() {
144        if (cond.getLB().contains(z)) {
145            if (!PropUtil.isDomIntersectDom(x, y)) {
146                return ESat.FALSE;
147            }
148            return x.isInstantiated() && y.isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
149        } else if (!cond.getUB().contains(z)) {
150            if (!x.contains(0)) {
151                return ESat.FALSE;
152            }
153            return x.isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
154        }
155        return ESat.TRUE;
156    }
157
158    @Override
159    public String toString() {
160        return "if " + z + " in " + cond + " { " + x + " = " + y + " } else { " + x + " = 0}";
161    }
162}
